caption:
Greek Chicken but make it sheet-pan with loads of veggies and a lemon sauce (Ladolemono) 🍋 If you’re looking for a NEW easy recipe that packs protein in fiber in one pan, this is it!

This Greek Sheet Pan Chicken is the ultimate one pan meal for busy weeknights. Were talking juicy chicken thighs, crisp veggies, and salty feta cheese all tossed in a garlicky Ladolemono sauce that is pure gold.

It’s the perfect dinner ideas inspiration hen you want authentic Greek food flavors without the mountain of dishes. Truly the best Mediterranean food made simple!

Ingredients:
For the Ladolemono Dressing
• Fresh lemon juice
• Dried oregano
• Garlic
• Kosher salt
• Black pepper
• Extra virgin olive oil

For the Chicken & Veggies
• Red onion
• Zucchini
• Orange bell pepper
• Tomato
• Kosher salt
• Black pepper
• Boneless, skinless chicken thighs
• Kalamata olives
• Castelvetrano olives
• Feta cheese
• Italian parsley

transcript: Greek sheet pan chicken. It's so good. Slice up some veggies, and then we're just gonna spread them out. Flavor our entire sheet pan with this magic sauce. Lado limono, which is basically a Greek lemon sauce. Season the chicken thighs, and then I nestle them in between the veggies. I told you it's a flavor party, didn't I? Going in the oven, 425 for about 35 minutes or so, or until the chicken is fully cooked through.
title: Greek Sheet Pan Chicken with Ladolemono
one_liner: Juicy Greek chicken thighs roasted with veggies, olives, and feta in a lemon-garlic sauce.
key_points: Toss veggies and chicken thighs in Ladolemono (Greek lemon-olive oil-garlic sauce) on one sheet pan
Bake at 425°F for ~35 minutes until chicken is cooked through
Top with Kalamata and Castelvetrano olives plus crumbled feta for authentic Greek flavor
One-pan meal means minimal dishes for a protein- and fiber-packed weeknight dinner

instructions: Slice red onion, zucchini, orange bell pepper, and tomato
Spread veggies across a sheet pan
Whisk together lemon juice, oregano, garlic, salt, pepper, and olive oil to make Ladolemono sauce
Drizzle sauce over veggies and chicken thighs, tossing to coat
Nestle seasoned chicken thighs between the veggies on the pan
Bake at 425°F for about 35 minutes or until chicken is fully cooked through
Top with olives, crumbled feta, and fresh parsley before serving
